Adding my quick security take — took a pass on HelioCare_Security-Profile.xlsx. High-level observations:

- Positives: encryption-at-rest, TLS for transport, basic RBAC matrix included.
- Gaps: no explicit KMS/HSM integration detail (we need key rotation policy and KMS ARN), missing data retention timelines for audit log retention, and no mention of customer-managed VPC options for the private deployment path.

Suggested short list for HelioCare to close (for ACE intake):
1) Add KMS integration detail (ARN + rotation cadence)
2) State retention windows for logs and model outputs (30/90/365) and whether logs are exported to a controlled archive
3) Clarify whether any PHI will be processed — if yes, supply HIPAA BAAs or plan for Private deployment.
